description: Validates explicitly supplied current USDA FSIS active MPI directory and demographic CSV files, then normalizes regulated establishments, activities, grants, names, addresses, coordinates, ZIP coverage, provenance, and explicit limitations.
redirect_policy: No network acquisition occurs inside this connector. Operators obtain both files from the two exact official links on the FSIS source page.
retry: Do not retry schema, join, date, checksum, or quality failures. Replace inputs only with a newly verified official pair.
checkpoint: Both complete source CSVs are retained and hashed before normalization; publication is run-scoped and current.json changes only after all quality gates pass.
idempotency: Source date plus both source-file SHA-256 values identify a release; FSIS establishment ID produces stable site and establishment candidates.
cancellation: Stop local processing, leave unpublished staging run-scoped, and do not change current.json before complete publication.
retention_profile: Retain immutable source files internally and normalized public releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
